title: Two Work Packages write the same two story files and two fragments for legacy RWB-AD-005 on rwb-access
source: Work Package files _work/msr/wp/B-P4-02.md and _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-004.md (both list the same 'Write only' paths 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P4 rwb-access (Access and authority)/RWB P4 AD005 APP Separation of duty check at sign-in v1.md and RWB P4 AD005 CON Separation of duty check at sign-in - contract v1.md, and the same two fragment paths _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD005-APP.json and RWB-P4-AD005-CON.json); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (two slices for legacy RWB-AD-005: RWB-P4-AD005-CON in lane CG-W4 and RWB-P4-AD005-APP in lane L-P4-A, both wave 4, both owner TechX, disposition Split (rework), patterns DP03, DP05, DP06, DP13, DP19); _work/msr/status.json (no entry for B-P4-02 and no entry for B2-P4-004); _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD005.part.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD005.part.jsonl (the citation set the two delivered files carry)
section: Whole story file set of RWB-AD-005 on rwb-access; fragments _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD005-APP.json and RWB-P4-AD005-CON.json
description: The plan carries two slices for legacy RWB-AD-005 on rwb-access (the contract baseline RWB-P4-AD005-CON and the application slice RWB-P4-AD005-APP), but two Work Packages of the run name them. B-P4-02 lists RWB-AD-005 beside RWB-AD-002, AD-003, AD-004 and AD-006 with fanout 5 and delivered the AD005 key in that fanout at 16:59 and 17:04 on 22 November 2026; B2-P4-004 names the same two story files and the same two fragments alone with fanout 0. The four artefacts are present and complete: the story files are 64,533 and 50,054 bytes, both carry the two header lines of Template and Rules v1 R8.1, a D-RCV-60 change-log row with the tool line T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, the 20 metadata rows of R7.1 in order with the Work Package values (work types APP and CON, the fixed TechX owner phrase, service rwb-access, epic RWB-SVC-P4, wave 4, business epic EP08, release 30 June 2027 (tentative), legacy key RWB-AD-005, disposition Split (rework), build status Not started, patterns DP03, DP05, DP06, DP13, DP19, lanes L-P4-A and CG-W4, ready After RWB-P4-E1022-APP and Day 1, H and C rows equal to the Work Package, PRD reference Pending (C1), status Draft (realignment v1)), the 19 section headings in order, tables 12.1 to 12.9 (the CON 12.9 heading written without the R7.2 parenthetical), the R7.2 Level column in section 16, and no 'As built (monolith)' heading because neither slice is preserved; the APP file carries AC1 and AC2 of RWB-AD-005 word for word with the origin tags '(legacy RWB-AD-005 AC1)' and '(legacy RWB-AD-005 AC2)', the pair RW-WRITEOFF and RW-WOCOMM, the refused session, the incident to the security administrator and the approved new version unchanged, and one added Given line 'Given the platform library contract mock returns the decision-record entry accepted on "rwb.decision-record.v1" for the refusal'; the CON file tags its eight criteria '(new, D-RCV-60)' and tests only the contract artefact; both keep TC-AD-005-01 to TC-AD-005-04 with the Level column. The two fragments parse, carry 28 keys each and hold the same metadata, operations, events and citation lists as the files. All 15 CG and ASM identifiers the two files cite (CG-B-P4-02-AD005-1, CG-B-P4-02-AD005-2 and ASM-B-P4-02-AD005-1 to ASM-B-P4-02-AD005-13) resolve to a row in the B-P4-02 part registers. The content is therefore sound, and what is duplicated is the Work Package, not the work.
evidence: B-P4-02.md title line 'fanout: 5' with lines 22, 23, 33 and 34 listing the two RWB P4 AD005 story paths and the RWB-P4-AD005 fragment paths, and story lines 68 and 69 for RWB-P4-AD005-APP and RWB-P4-AD005-CON; B2-P4-004.md 'fanout: 0' with the same four paths on lines 9 to 12 and the same two story lines 42 and 43; split_plan.json slices RWB-P4-AD005-CON (CG-W4) and RWB-P4-AD005-APP (L-P4-A) with legacy RWB-AD-005 disposition Split (rework) and both slices listed; status.json holds no 'B-P4-02' key and no 'B2-P4-004' key; there is no edit log at _work/msr/editlog/B-P4-02.md although _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD005.part.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD005.part.jsonl exist (2 and 13 rows); file times 22 November 2026 16:59:02 and 17:04:40 for the two story files and 17:07:34 for the two fragments; the same duplication was found for RWB-AD-003 in B2-P4-002 and was resolved the other way for RWB-AD-002 in B2-P4-001, which regenerated both files in place at 20:05 on the same day
proposed: Keep one Work Package per story slice in the plan generator: remove RWB-AD-005 from the B-P4-02 fanout list, or retire B2-P4-004 for this key. At step D1, number CG-B-P4-02-AD005-1 and -2 and ASM-B-P4-02-AD005-1 to -13 once and allocate no second set for B2-P4-004, so that the 15 citations the two delivered files carry keep one row each. Pick one settling rule for the whole B2 queue, because B2-P4-001 rewrote the AD002 pair in place while B2-P4-002 kept the AD003 pair: either every B2 Work Package owns its two paths and rewrites them with its own citation set, or every duplicate keeps the first delivery and records the collision as this row does. Ask the B-P4-02 run to write the edit log row its four artefacts lack.
